items.title: Video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari' attack

items.title: Oil prices fall on hopes Strait of Hormuz could reopen

items.title: EU commends Spain's 'swift response' to Ceuta migrant crisis

items.title: More than 170 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel

items.title: What will happen when a SpaceX rocket collides with the Moon?

items.title: Mass funeral in Gaza for 112 Palestinians killed in 2023 Israeli strike
items.description: The bodies - belonging to members of two extended families - have only recently been recovered from under rubble in Gaza City.
